AdminSessionItem.description:
EF-USR-011 asks for the device, `auth_time` and the last activity of every profile, not for
where its members and children connect from: no address in the admin's view (review m3).
AdminSessionItem.title: AdminSessionItem

non_family_source_into_family_shelf.title: Non Family Source Into Family Shelf

BulkFilter.description: A filter of the list, frozen by the preview into the Works it matched then.
BulkFilter.title: BulkFilter

ChoiceOut.description: A binding a key can be linked to: its shelf, its server, and whether one is linked.
ChoiceOut.title: ChoiceOut

DeviceOut.description: What the registry shows of a device: never the secret, never what verifies it.
DeviceOut.title: DeviceOut

DeviceRotateIn.description: Only a token past its expiry needs `expires_days`: a new secret would be refused as it is.
DeviceRotateIn.title: DeviceRotateIn

DeviceSkippedOut.description: A Kavita target left out, and why (`address_unusable`): the screen says so.
DeviceSkippedOut.title: DeviceSkippedOut

DeviceTargetOut.description: Kavita's own entry points: addresses only, never a key or a token.
DeviceTargetOut.title: DeviceTargetOut

DeviceTokenPairIn.description:
`subject_user_id` is the profile the reader reads as: omitted, it is the caller's own (an
admin has to name one, as an admin cannot be a subject).
DeviceTokenPairIn.title: DeviceTokenPairIn

DeviceTokenPaired.description: What is shown once. `secret` is typed as it is: no separator, case kept.
DeviceTokenPaired.title: DeviceTokenPaired

EditionSuggestionOut.description:
An open suggested age above an Edition's: rating the Work leaves it open and the Edition
stays out of the shelves below 18+ until `rate_edition`.
EditionSuggestionOut.title: EditionSuggestionOut

FamilyItemOut.description:
What a child sees of a remote result: a title and the one action. No cover, no summary, no
format, no source name or key: only what a request needs, by an opaque reference.
FamilyItemOut.title: FamilyItemOut

FamilyOut.description:
The family search of a child (EF-USR-014): the sources marked "family" and the rated
catalogue, with no total, no count and no word on what was dropped or hidden.
FamilyOut.title: FamilyOut

FamilySearchIn.description:
The family search of a child profile (EF-USR-018): both fields are given, so a call never
changes one by leaving the other out; the words are bounded (and folded when stored).
FamilySearchIn.title: FamilySearchIn

HealthPageOut.description:
The Health page (EF-SRC-014, EF-BIB-031, EF-BIB-051, EF-INT-015, EF-INT-025). The nested
documents are typed by the code of their entries; none holds a secret, a phrase or a path.
HealthPageOut.title: HealthPageOut

JobAccepted.description: Body of a 202: the job to poll (the same URL is in the `Location` header).
JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted

KavitaAccountIn.description:
The name of the Kavita account of a child, or null to clear it. Nothing else is accepted:
no token, no key, no password (EF-USR-017: the mapping is declarative).
KavitaAccountIn.title: KavitaAccountIn

LinkIn.description:
The key and, for an adult, the name of the Kavita account it opens. Nothing else: a child's
account is the one her parent declared.
LinkIn.title: LinkIn

LinkedOut.description:
The answer to a link: the account, and what was worth saying once (`kavita_admin`: the key
is of an administrator account of Kavita, which an adult may hold).
LinkedOut.title: LinkedOut

NamingPreviewOut.description: `verified` false is the "not verified" mark: Kavita could not confirm the names.
NamingPreviewOut.title: NamingPreviewOut

NamingTemplateIn.description: The fields of a candidate template; what is left out is the default's.
NamingTemplateIn.title: NamingTemplateIn

NotificationPrefsIn.description: The whole of it, replaced at once. Nothing names a person: the caller's row is the one.
NotificationPrefsIn.title: NotificationPrefsIn

OidcIdentityItem.description: A link of the caller's account: the provider and since when, never the identifier.
OidcIdentityItem.title: OidcIdentityItem

OidcLastUnlink.description:
The last removal of a link of this account: the trace for a person whose notice had no
destination to go to (it is never told in the shared channels).
OidcLastUnlink.title: OidcLastUnlink

OidcLinkStart.description: Where to send the browser: the provider's page, with the flow already begun.
OidcLinkStart.title: OidcLinkStart

PasskeyFlow.description: A challenge and the browser options for `navigator.credentials` (base64url fields).
PasskeyFlow.title: PasskeyFlow

PasskeyReauth.description: The assertion answers a challenge from `/api/v1/auth/passkeys/reauth/options`.
PasskeyReauth.title: PasskeyReauth

PreferencesIn.description:
Only what is named is changed; `theme: null` goes back to the instance default. An
explicit `language: null` is refused: a language is a choice, the default is already the
profile's (ENF-I18N-001).
PreferencesIn.title: PreferencesIn

Problem.description: RFC 9457 body, as documented in the OpenAPI schema.
Problem.title: Problem

ProgressRead.description: A position, or nothing at all (`{}`): KOReader then says "no progress found".
ProgressRead.title: ProgressRead

RatedOut.description:
The Work is rated; the files a raised age no longer lets stay on a shelf below 18+ are
listed in `withdrawals` and nothing was taken out (`shelf withdraw`, EF-BIB-037).
RatedOut.title: RatedOut

ReauthRequiredProblem.description:
`reauth-required` (EF-USR-022): how old the last password entry is, and the age allowed.
Nothing else about the session leaves with it. `-1`: no usable `auth_time`.
ReauthRequiredProblem.title: ReauthRequiredProblem

RenamePlanIn.description:
Either a template (the fields given are the candidate's, the rest the default's) or a list
of moves (reshelving, binding migration): one of the two, never both, never neither.
RenamePlanIn.title: RenamePlanIn

RequestOut.description: What the person who asked sees: her own request, nothing about how it is handled.
RequestOut.title: RequestOut

RootIn.description:
`path`: a folder the database does not know yet (`foreign_root` found by the start-up),
named by its absolute path instead of the `root_id` of the URL.
RootIn.title: RootIn

SearchedInOut.description: One line of "Searched in...": a source that was asked, by key and name (never an address).
SearchedInOut.title: SearchedInOut

SecretsImportIn.description:
Two plain file names in `<data folder>/import/` on the host of the server: the passphrase
never travels in the request, and the caller picks no path.
SecretsImportIn.title: SecretsImportIn

TrashEntryOut.description: One deletion of one Unit in the bins: never a path, never a title.
TrashEntryOut.title: TrashEntryOut

UserExportOut.description:
One person's data (EF-USR-013). Nothing that proves or opens something is in it, and a Work
is named by its identifier, never by a title.
UserExportOut.title: UserExportOut

WebhookCreated.description: The answer to the creation: the only one that carries the secret.
WebhookCreated.title: WebhookCreated

WizardPreviewAccepted.description: Body of the 202 of a preview that takes longer than a request may: ask `status_url`.
WizardPreviewAccepted.title: WizardPreviewAccepted

WizardToCheckOut.description:
A file whose first page or archive the decode worker or the safe opener refused: adopted
all the same, never touched, for the admin to look at (`reason` is a code of a closed list).
WizardToCheckOut.title: WizardToCheckOut

WorkOut.description: A Work as the sources name it; `appended`: it was shown before, these Editions are new.
WorkOut.title: WorkOut

shelfhold__interfaces__http_api__plans__.description: The confirmation that readers lose their progress (EF-EXP-037); nothing else.
shelfhold__interfaces__http_api__plans__.title: ApplyIn

The "Register" button of KOReader: refused, whoever asks and whatever it sends. The
device shows `message` (`doRegister`): in the language of the request, both when it names

get.description:
A version made earlier, by its identifier: the profile's own only (any other is an
absent one), and every chapter is checked again against the manifest and the scope.

body.data: object, identifiers, counts and codes only: never a title
body.event_id: integer, the number of the event
body.schema_version: integer, the version of the shape of `data`

delivery.deprecation: while a shape is deprecated, an event is sent twice (the old version, then the current one), for at most 180 days

headers.X-Shelfhold-Delivery: identity of the delivery, the same at every retry: drop a second copy
headers.X-Shelfhold-Schema-Version: the version of the shape of `data`
headers.X-Shelfhold-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.' followed by the exact body, keyed by the secret given once at registration>

delivery.retries: 8 attempts, the delay doubling from 30 s up to 6 h; a 2xx answer settles it; a redirection is not followed
